name: The Panasonic television's power button: its own remote against the Harmony 650
description: How many power frames the TX-P42GT30E's original remote sends for a tap and for a hold, against the seven the Harmony 650 sends, section 306 and the addendum in docs/predictions-power-hold.md. Keep each remote pointed at the Flirc. The frame count per step is the measurement, so the steps carry no count.

steps.instruction: With the original Panasonic remote, tap Volume up once, briefly. This is only to check the receiver hears that remote
With the television off, tap the original remote's Power button once, as quickly as you can, and note whether the television switches on
Once it is on, tap Power once quickly again, so it is off
Hold the original remote's Power button down for about two seconds, then release, and note whether the television switches on
Tap Power once to switch it off again, and wait until it is off
On the Harmony 650, start the activity that switches the Panasonic on, and wait until the remote is done
Press Off on the Harmony 650 and wait until the remote is done
